name: Ship Resistance and Propulsion
description: Ship resistance: components of resistance, dimensional analysis, scaling laws, frictional and wave-making resistance, appendage and shallow-water effects, hull roughness, initial resistance estimation methods, high-speed craft resistance. Model testing: experimental techniques, correlation allowance, global standards for resistance estimation. Propulsion: propeller geometry, propulsion theories, open water and behind-hull propeller performance, cavitation, propulsive efficiency, unconventional propulsion devices. Propeller design: methodical series, circulation theory, engine-propeller matching, speed trials. Computational and experimental methods: application of CFD, empirical formulations, model testing, and power estimation techniques for optimized ship performance.
